why: DERIVED, never typed: 457 entries with 1744 declared inputs is not a list anybody maintains by hand, and a hand-maintained one agrees with the library on the day it is written and lies afterwards. `npm run proof` verifies every line of it.

vendor.why: EXACTLY, never a range. Every digest below is a number this exact build produced; a range would let the numbers move while the check stayed green, which is the failure this file exists to prevent. Both are devDependencies: `packaging.spec.ts` forbids declaring them as dependencies and `test/boundary.spec.ts` forbids importing either from `src/`.

fixture.why: the seeded fixture `scripts/indicator-proof/bars.mjs` builds and asserts ten properties of, so that a null answer from it means something

sealMeaning.constrained: a family invariant that holds regardless of implementation applies AND passes
sealMeaning.structural: it draws, is deterministic, is pure, is aligned and sits on the scale it declares — nothing is claimed about the values

exclusions.measurement: declared overlay:true, and its plots are ABSOLUTE Bitcoin price bands: median |value| 370956 against a price median of 116 on fixture A, and off the price neighbourhood on fixture B at 4200 as well. Correct for BTC, catastrophic for anything else — and a generic catalogue offers it against whatever instrument the workspace is showing. Repositioning it to its own pane would draw the bands correctly and still say nothing about the instrument on screen, so it is excluded rather than moved
"MACD 1226 Hist" equals "MACD 1226 Line" on all 998 indices; a MACD histogram is line - signal by definition

declared overlay:true; five plots sit on the price scale and `osc` ("Oscillator") has a median |value| of 0.35 against a price median of 116, on both fixtures. One entry carrying two scales has no single correct `placement`: over-price renders the oscillator off-axis and own-pane renders the five moving averages off-axis. Excluded rather than repositioned, because either choice draws something wrong
"MACD Histogram" equals "MACD" on all 1004 indices; a MACD histogram is line - signal by definition

declares plot0 "T3" and plot1 "T3fibo", and the result carries only plot0 unless `showFibo` is true, which defaults to false. The manifest cannot promise plot1. Reducing the promise to plot0 was measured and rejected: `showFibo`, `lengthFibo` and `volumeFactorFibo` would then be three offered controls whose only effect is a plot the manifest does not draw, and holding them back would need a ledger of a third kind — they are not inert, so the inert ledger would become a lie about them. Excluding the one entry costs less than inventing that ledger
